description: Append one typed event to an authorized thread. Use message for ordinary text; action_request for one advertised capability; action_confirmation for the exact proposed external effect; approval_confirmation with decision allow or deny for one additional permission; completion_confirmation to accept a result without authorizing a new effect; or cancellation_request to ask the provider to cancel one operation. Exact request and operation IDs must come from get_thread. Plain text never grants authority, a cancellation request is not confirmed cancellation, and durable acceptance is not remote completion.

attachments.description: Optional Darwin asset references, allowed only with messageType message; never inline base64 or secrets.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional caller-generated retry key. Reuse it only for an unchanged retry after an unknown outcome.

account.description: Optional saved external-account reference. This is an opaque Darwin ID, never a token or secret.

arguments.description: Arguments for that capability, matching its advertised input schema. Never include credentials or payment details.

capability.description: Exact executable capability identifier returned by Search or get_thread.

request.description: Exact immutable request identifier returned by get_thread.

decision.description: Approval decision: allow authorizes only the referenced request; deny rejects only that request. Neither value substitutes for another request type.

request.description: Exact immutable approval request identifier returned by get_thread.

operation.description: Exact operation identifier returned by get_thread whose cancellation should be requested.

messageContent.description: Content required by messageType: message uses non-empty text; action_request uses {capability, arguments, account?}; action_confirmation and completion_confirmation use {request}; approval_confirmation uses {request, decision} with decision allow or deny; cancellation_request uses {operation}. Exact request and operation IDs must come from get_thread. Never place credentials, payment details, or approval authority in text.

messageType.description: Typed event mode. Supported values are message, action_request, action_confirmation, approval_confirmation, completion_confirmation, and cancellation_request.

thread.description: Authorized thread identifier returned by start_thread, get_thread, or list_threads.

name: send_message
title: Send message
